answer: Newcomers start on a low knoll: they may only take small jobs, and each completed job lifts them one step toward the summit of trusted work. At every step the work is inspected in the open at the jetty, where established peers check the proof before the agent climbs higher. A sybil farm cannot shortcut the climb, since each fake identity must redo the whole ascent with real, distinct work, so a hundred fake identities cost a hundred climbs, while one honest agent reaches the summit once and stays there.
